subject: CAIQ intake and evidence escalation roadmap for SkyBank
messages:

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake and evidence orchestration for SkyBank

Hi Lucille,

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Attaching an initial CAIQ crosswalk (redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx) that maps our controls to the CSA questions you flagged. This should make it easier to see where artifacts exist versus where we need to collect samples.

Can you confirm the scope (all Redwood-hosted inference endpoints + Private VPC connectors) and the deadline you need? Our proposed plan:
- Day 0: confirm scope and control owners
- Day 1-3: internal evidence harvest and owner assignments
- Day 4-7: package delivery to your secure intake portal (or shared Drive link)

If that works, I can share an "owner roster" and instructions for uploads. I've cc'd Priyom (security ops) to own the proof collection and Naomi (CS) for customer coordination.

Attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lucille Park <lpark@skybank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: SkyBank Procurement <procurements@skybank.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and evidence orchestration for SkyBank

Ben —

Appreciate the crosswalk. Scope confirmed: Redwood-hosted inference (hosted API) plus Dedicated pools for any contracted reserved capacity. Please include Private deployments as "in-scope if deployed to our VPCs" (we will flag any that are out of scope).

Primary asks from our side:
1) For each CSA control (we care most about IAM controls, key management, telemetry/logging, and tenant isolation), please provide: control owner, retained artifact type, sample path (or Drive link), and a short narrative (1-2 lines) tying the artifact to the control.
2) Runtime telemetry samples for a representative 24-hour window for inference traces (anonymized)
3) Evidence of key rotation + KMS attestation for any customer-managed keys used in Private deployment
4) SOC 2 Type II report and the date range it covers

We need the initial package by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-11). If that's a hard date for you, include a prioritized subset (critical controls first). We will also share our CAIQ with in-line annotations and a PDF with requirement flags (see attached).

Attachments: SkyBank_CAIQ_Request_20270509.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to the owner roster and upload instructions.

— Lucille Park
Director, Security Assurance | SkyBank
lpark@skybank.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and evidence orchestration for SkyBank

Lucille —

Thanks, scope confirmed. Quoting your asks below and proposing an execution approach.

> Primary asks from our side:
> 1) For each CSA control ... provide: control owner, retained artifact type, sample path, and a short narrative
> 2) Runtime telemetry samples for a representative 24-hour window
> 3) Evidence of key rotation + KMS attestation
> 4) SOC 2 Type II report and the date range

Action plan (owners assigned):
- Control roster & narratives (owner_roster.csv) — owner: Priyom Das (security ops). ETA: Tue 2027-05-11 17:00 PT
- Telemetry sample extraction (anonymized) — owner: Naomi Feldman (customer reliability). ETA: Tue 2027-05-11 17:00 PT
- KMS/key rotation proofs — owner: Priyom Das. ETA: Tue 2027-05-11 17:00 PT
- SOC 2 report (we will attach the most recent Type II) — owner: Ben Carter (sales) - will include report and coverage dates in the package

Upload mechanism: we have prepared a secure intake folder and a short upload runbook (evidence_upload_instructions.md). I will place incremental bundles in the Drive folder and notify you as they appear. If you prefer SFTP/S3 ingest, let us know; otherwise Drive link below is ready.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cGX-skybank-caiq
HubSpot reference: HS-918273

Attachments: owner_roster.csv, evidence_upload_instructions.md

We will prioritize IAM, KMS, and tenant-isolation artifacts first, then follow up with telemetry. If anything is out of scope for us to produce (for example third-party-hosted logs), we'll call it out clearly.

Can you confirm that Tuesday EOD (your timezone) is acceptable for the initial bundle? If you need parts of the package earlier, we can push the IAM/KMS subset by Monday EOD.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Lucille Park <lpark@skybank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, SkyBank Procurement <procurements@skybank.com>

Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and evidence orchestration for SkyBank

Ben / team —

That plan looks good. Tuesday EOD is acceptable; procurement also asked us to get the prioritized IAM/KMS subset by Monday EOD so they can attach to the purchasing packet. Thanks for calling out which artifacts might be third-party-limited.

One extra ask: please include a short control-level statement for tenant isolation describing runtime segregation (how requests and KV caches are partitioned) — 2-3 sentences per control should be sufficient. If you can place that in the owner_roster.csv narrative column it will help.

We will monitor the Drive link and confirm receipt. Please copy procurements@skybank.com on the final package.

— Lucille
